description: This Java source file defines the VersionChecker class, which handles checking for version updates of the Java console, firmware, and critical issues by fetching data from a remote URL. It provides mechanisms for notifying users about available updates or critical issues and manages version-related configurations.

classes.name: VersionChecker
classes.description: Manages version checking by fetching version data from a remote server, parsing it, and displaying update or critical issue warnings to the user.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the background process that reads version information from a remote URL.

methods.name: readAndProcess
methods.description: Fetches and reads version data from the specified URL, then updates the user interface if needed.

methods.name: parseNotNull
methods.description: Parses a string to an integer, throwing an exception if null.

methods.name: showUpdateWarningIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays a warning dialog to the user if their version is outdated.

methods.name: getPaneParent
methods.description: Returns the parent component for dialog display.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the VersionChecker.

methods.name: onFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Checks the firmware version string against the latest recommended version and prompts the user if an update is needed.
